proof.text: Evaluate the kernel inclusion k_N on an object v(W) over the open. The actual open-unit normalization in hRestriction and k_N followed by the unit equal to zero show that restriction of k_N(x) along p:v(u(v(W)))→v(W) is zero. The composition/base-change adjunction supplies b with b≫p=1 by its left triangle identity. Restricting once more along b gives k_N(x)=0. Evaluation preserves the monic kernel inclusion, so x=0. The additive equivalence rho then makes j*F(N) zero. Apply hSupported, and whisker the closed unit with F to obtain theta with precisely the required components.

For f:i*M→N, naturality of the open unit and hVanishing give f≫r_N=0. Define the transpose by the fully faithful preimage of kernel.lift(r_N,f)≫theta_N. Its inverse sends g to i*(g)≫theta_N inverse≫k_N. The kernel lifting equation, theta inverse identities and faithfulness prove both inverse laws. Naturality follows by kernel cancellation and naturality of theta. Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv constructs the adjunction and computes its counit as theta inverse followed by the kernel inclusion.

The universe-polymorphic arbitrary-ring module-sheaf theorem gives IsGrothendieckAbelian for the actual finite-coefficient category on T, with coefficient/module universe u+1 and site object/morphism universes u+1,u. The Grothendieck K-injective-resolution instance applies. Exactness of closed pushforward and Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes show H sends every K-injective complex to a K-injective complex.

Use the existing unbounded rightDerivedFunctor H and its homotopy-category unit. The canonical mapHomotopyCategoryFactors and quotientCompQhIso give the comparison beta on complexes. Precomposition with the homotopy quotient is fully faithful on functor categories: explicitly lift a transformation through its full whiskering functor and prove uniqueness by faithfulness. The proved private Kan-extension helper and isLeftKanExtension_iff_postcompose transport the right-derived universal property to complexes, also after postcomposition with exact closed pushforward. The comparison beta is invertible on each K-injective complex by the existing K-injective derivability structure.

Exactness supplies mapDerivedCategory and its factorization isomorphism. An invertible factorization is an absolute left-derived comparison. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.derived to the termwise complex adjunction, this exact-left comparison, and beta; the preceding step supplies the required right-derived absoluteness. Define c as the inverse exact-pushforward factorization followed by pushforward of asIso(beta_I). Adjunction.derivedε_fac_app identifies pushforward(beta_I) followed by the derived counit with the exact factorization followed by Q of the termwise counit. Precompose with the inverse factorization and cancel to obtain the stated final equality.

title: Closed support adjunction and its derived counit
statement:
Let $T$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]), let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with quasi-compact complementary open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and let $A$ be a finite ring, not necessarily commutative. Work in the left module sheaf categories on the small pro-etale sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Use their ordinary unbounded derived categories and localization functors $Q_S$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define $F(N)=\ker(N\to j_*j^*N)$ and $H(N)=i^*F(N)$ with the coefficient actions and units of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact].

Assume $i_*$ is exact and fully faithful. Assume also that $j^*$ is restriction, that $j^*i_*M=0$ for every left $A_Z$-module sheaf $M$, and that the closed unit $N\to i_*i^*N$ is an isomorphism for every left $A_T$-module sheaf $N$ with $j^*N=0$.

Then $i_*$ is left adjoint to $H$. Its sheaf counit $i_*H(N)\to N$ is the inverse of the supported unit $F(N)\xrightarrow{\sim}i_*i^*F(N)$ followed by the kernel inclusion. Let $RH$ be the total right derived functor of $H$ [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived]. For every K-injective complex $I$ (every map from an acyclic complex to $I$ is homotopic to zero [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]), the complex $H(I)$ is K-injective and $RH(Q_TI)=Q_ZH(I)$. Termwise $i_*$ induces a functor $i_*^D$ on the unbounded derived categories; one has $i_*^D\dashv RH$, and its counit at $Q_TI$ is $Q_T(i_*H(I)\to I)$ with the just specified termwise kernel inclusion. In particular $Q_Ti_*H(I)=i_*^D RH(Q_TI)$ under the canonical derived-functor comparisons.
